sources.review_notes: All 7 pages reviewed against page renders by one reviewer agent (reports/review-pages-0001-0007.md): equations (1)-(4) and inline maths transcribed to LaTeX from the authors' TeX and compared with 220 dpi crops; Figures 1-7 checked on all four edges (native labels of Figs. 2, 6, 7 inside the crops); Algorithm 1 kept as a crop with a line-numbered transcription; Table I checked cell by cell; references [1]-[32] reordered and split where the extractor had misplaced or merged them, every third entry checked character by character. Verifier diagnostics on pages 2-7 are LaTeX-notation, algorithm-transcription and one rejoined access date, adjudicated per page.
